column1: # The checks of shell/boot-manager.nsh, the UEFI Shell boot of boot-manager: get shows Boot0099 and
# Key0099 as tests/qemu/vars/boot-manager.json seeds them, as Linux showed them in boot 1;
# set-attributes refuses PlatformRecovery####, OsRecovery####, an absent load option and a flag both
# to set and to clear, leaving the global variables as they were; it clears and sets Boot0099's
# LOAD_OPTION_ACTIVE, keeping its undefined bit, and Key0099 follows it, and sets and clears
# Driver0000's LOAD_OPTION_FORCE_RECONNECT, as Linux did in boot 1. See check-shell-log.sh.
